instruction.text: Fred has some fish in a tank. <mat><t-yellow>3</t-yellow>/<t-purple>4</t-purple></mat> of his fish are clownfish. If he has 12 clownfish, how many fish does he have in total?

atoms.a: Divide by the numerator to find 1/4 of the quantity.
Then multiply by the denominator to find the whole quantity.

feedback.end: Fred has a total of <t-cyan>16 fish</t-cyan> in his tank.

instruction.text: Lara invited all her friends to her birthday party. <mat><t-yellow>2</t-yellow>/<t-purple>5</t-purple></mat> have already shown up. If there are already 12 friends, how many friends did she invite in total?

atoms.a: Divide by the numerator to find 1/5 of the quantity.
Then multiply by the denominator to find the whole quantity.

feedback.end: Lara invited a total of <t-cyan>30 friends</t-cyan>.

instruction.text: Sam has lots of homework to do. He has completed 2/3 so far. If he has completed 4 pieces, how many pieces of homework does he have to do in total?

atoms.a: Divide by the numerator to find 1/3 of the quantity.
Then multiply by the denominator to find the whole quantity.

feedback.end: Sam has <t-cyan>6 pieces of homework</t-cyan> in total.

instruction.text: Jane bought some bars of chocolate. <mat><t-yellow>5</t-yellow>/<t-purple>6</t-purple></mat> of the bars are milk chocolate. If 15 bars were milk chocolate, how many bars did she buy in total?

atoms.a: Divide by the numerator to find 1/6 of the quantity.
Then multiply by the denominator to find the whole quantity.

feedback.end: Jane bought <t-cyan>18 chocolate bars</t-cyan> in total.

instruction.text: Simone got some pocket money. She spends 4/5 of it on clothes. If she spent £8, how much money did she get in total?

atoms.a: Divide by the numerator to find 1/5 of the quantity.
Then multiply by the denominator to find the whole quantity.

instruction.text: There are a number of dogs in the park. 3/8 of them are Labradors. If there are 3 Labradors, how many dogs are there in total?

atoms.a: Divide by the numerator to find 1/8 of the quantity.
Then multiply by the denominator to find the whole quantity.
